simple.meaning: רָצַף (râtsaph) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to tessellate , i.e. embroider (as if with bright stones).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Song of Solomon, beginning at Song of Songs 3:10. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רָצַף (H7528) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: רָצַף (râtsaph) / H7528 is traced through Song of Songs 3:10 with source-language evidence and verse context.
